historyDialog.title: Version history
historyDialog.pendingChanges_one: You have {{count}} change since the last saved version. They'll be saved automatically in a moment.
historyDialog.pendingChanges_other: You have {{count}} changes since the last saved version. They'll be saved automatically in a moment.
historyDialog.noVersions: No versions saved yet. Edit the lesson and a version is saved automatically whenever you pause.
historyDialog.mergeTooltip: A merge — two histories joined here
historyDialog.origin: This is where the lesson began.
historyDialog.sameAsNow: This is exactly what the lesson looks like now.
historyDialog.undoError: That change could not be undone.
historyDialog.undoTooltip: Put back what this version changed, and keep everything since.

mergeDialog.deletedByThem: You edited this block; {{name}} deleted it. Keeping it preserves your edit.
mergeDialog.deletedByYou: You deleted this block; {{name}} edited it. Keeping it restores their version.
mergeDialog.reviewingNotice: Merging this updates the published lesson itself, for everyone reading it. Nothing is written until you confirm, and {{name}} will be told either way.

auto.heading: Merged automatically:
auto.merged_one: {{count}} block you both edited — in different fields, so both sets of edits were kept
auto.merged_other: {{count}} blocks you both edited — in different fields, so both sets of edits were kept

mergeDialog.noConflicts: Nothing is in conflict — the whole merge resolved on its own. Confirm to apply it.
mergeDialog.conflictsIntro_one: {{count}} block was edited on both sides in the same place. Choose which to keep.
mergeDialog.conflictsIntro_other: {{count}} blocks were edited on both sides in the same place. Choose which to keep.
mergeDialog.tryingNotice: This goes into a variation of your own, not the lesson. Nothing anyone else sees changes, and the proposal stays open for you to decide on.

proposeDialog.title: Propose changes to {{name}}
proposeDialog.description: Send your version of this lesson to {{name}} as a proposal.
proposeDialog.notice: Nothing in {{name}} changes yet. Its author — or someone they trust with it — reviews your changes and decides whether to merge them. Everyone can see what you propose.
proposeDialog.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Add five more spelling words to section 2
proposeDialog.titleHint: One line, so the author can tell at a glance what you're offering.
proposeDialog.bodyPlaceholder: Why these changes help, anything you weren't sure about...
proposeDialog.bodyHint: Plain text. This is a note to the author, not part of the lesson.

description.add: Search free images from <link>{{source}}</link> and add one to this section.
description.replace: Search free images from <link>{{source}}</link> and swap it in for the current one.

errors.emptyQuery: Type something to search for first.
errors.verificationRequired: Please complete the verification challenge first.
errors.verificationExpired: Verification expired — wait a moment and try again.

imageSearch.noResults: No images found. Try different words.

variations.title: Variations
variations.description: A variation is a separate copy of this lesson you can change freely. The main lesson stays exactly as it is until you bring a variation into it.
variations.changesAhead_one: {{count}} change that isn't in the main lesson
variations.changesAhead_other: {{count}} changes that aren't in the main lesson
variations.privacy: Variations are saved with the lesson, so anyone who can open the lesson can see them.
variations.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}”? Anything only in this variation goes with it.

lessonsDialog.title: Lessons on this device
lessonsDialog.description: Everything you’re working on, kept in this browser. Open one to switch to it — nothing is overwritten.
lessonsDialog.storageNote: These lessons live in this browser. Deleting one takes its version history with it, and clearing your browsing data removes them all — save a lesson to the cloud to keep a copy off this device.
